3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the issue of maintainability as pointed out by the Registry is baseless as he has moved NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:25842 2 CRA-2835-2026 the other bail application on 28.03.2026 and it has been filed along with I.A.
No.2423/2026.
This Court vide order dated 13th March, 2026 in Cr.A. No.905/2026 has dismissed the bail application as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh after filing of the charge sheet.
The charge sheet has been filed on 24.03.2026 and thereafter he has moved this second bail application.
The appellant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering her appeal for bail.
It is also submitted that conclusion of the trial will take time.
In view of the aforesaid, she prays for grant of bail.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application/appeal and prayed for its rejection.
